Suppose your SL is 5% away. Maximum risk = $5 SL distance = 5% Position size = $5 ÷ 5% = $100 Only after this calculate the leverage according to the margin you want to use. posts.text: CAN THESE CRAZY BULL RUN TARGETS REALLY HAPPEN? Bull markets can push prices far beyond expectations, but market cap matters more than hype. $BTC at $195K, $ETH at $14.6K, and BNB above $3K are aggressive but still within the realm of a powerful bull cycle. $SOL at $2,300+ and HYPE near $859 would require extremely large capital inflows. The mistake many traders make is looking only at price. Always calculate: Target Price × Circulating Supply = Required Market Cap In a bull run, anything can pump hard but tokenomics and market cap tell you whether the target actually makes sense.

posts.text: $XAU time for sell, open big short now and make money with me entry 4135-4165 sl 4180 tp 4099-4050 Short $XAU 👇 {future}(XAUUSDT) Why did $XAU and $BTC sell off together on Oct 7? On the surface, these two markets look completely unrelated. But underneath, they can react to the same macro pressure. A stronger USD, rising US yields, and Brent pushing above $100 all mean tighter financial conditions and less risk appetite. Gold gets pressured because it doesn’t generate yield. Bitcoin gets pressured because it’s still trading more like a risk asset, with leverage making the move even sharper. Bottom line: when yields and the USD rise together, the market is repricing the real cost of capital and the possibility that the Fed stays restrictive for longer.

posts.text: 🇺🇸 The U.S. is making a serious move to lead the stablecoin era.
